text:
A radioactive material is emitting α-particles. The radioactive material is used in a demonstration
in a school laboratory experiment.
Which safety precaution must be taken by the person carrying out the experiment?
A
Handle the source with tongs.
B
Place the source on a heat-proof mat.
C
Surround the experiment with a lead screen.
D
Wear goggles.

options.label: B
options.text: Place the source on a heat-proof mat.

options.label: C
options.text: Surround the experiment with a lead screen.
